g.text: Does PMM improve the local-process reconstruction?
Positive = lower conditional reconstruction RMSE with PMM; not initialization forecast skill.
0–50 m shown; all 30/50/75 m settings in CSV. OLS is a diagnostic sensitivity, not a replacement dynamical model.
